primary.title: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold rebounds above $4,070; silver at $59 as investors assess Middle East tensions
primary.summary: The prices of precious metals gold and silver increased on 24 July, driven by the Middle Eastern conflict and anticipation of US rate hikes. Gold prices reached an intraday high of $4,073, while silver rose to $58.98, with both metals showing weekly gains amid global market uncertainty.
